content_sections.heading: Punjab SSSB Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the Punjab SSSB Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download Punjab SSSB Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Driver: Matriculation, Valid driving licence for light and heavy vehicles, Minimum 3 years driving experience Clerk (Legal): Law Graduate Clerk (Accounts): Graduation with Statistics or Mathematics or Accounts, Matriculation with Punjabi / Degree of commerce from a recognized University or Institution Clerk (I.T.): Graduate/B.Tech in Computer Science / IT / BCA / PGDCA / Degree in B.E./B.Tech in IT/ECE/CSE or BCA with 2 years experience Translator: Graduation, 120 hours computer course or equivalent Field Artist: Graduate in Music or Drama or Dance

content_sections.text: Written Exam (MCQ, Part A & Part B) Typing Test (Punjabi & English where applicable, 30 wpm) Document Verification / Counseling

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Punjab SSSB Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 19-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Punjab SSSB to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is being conducted by the Punjab Subordinate Services Selection Board (Punjab SSSB) for filling 70 vacancies across multiple positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced under Advt No. 12 of 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 70 vacancies have been announced for various posts including Clerks, Drivers, Field Artists, and Translators under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. When does the online application process start and end?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 25-09-2026 and the last date to submit applications along with the fee payment is 19-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The general age limit is set from 18 to 37 years as of the qualifying date, with standard age relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What educational qualification is required for the Clerk posts?
faq.answer: Qualifications vary by specific clerk profiles, requiring Graduation, Law degrees, Commerce degrees, or IT/Computer Science degrees like BCA/B.Tech/PGDCA along with Punjabi language proficiency.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for applying to Punjab SSSB Recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, application fees vary by category, ranging from Rs. 200 for Ex-Servicemen & Dependents to Rs. 1000 for General Category/Sports applicants.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process typically includes a Written Examination (MCQ based), Typing Tests where applicable, and Document Verification/Counseling rounds.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the Punjab SSSB Various Posts?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official website at sssb.punjab.gov.in, completing registration, filling out the form, uploading documents, and paying fees online.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The positions offer pay scales compliant with the 7th CPC, ranging from Level 2 to Level 5, with basic pay scales starting from 19900 up to 69100.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF directly from the important links section provided in this article or from the official SSSB Punjab website.
